name: Weatherford Marketplace
summary: Weatherford Marketplace is a Target-anchored community shopping center on South Main Street in Weatherford, Texas, serving as a convenient retail destination for Parker County residents. With strong customer ratings and extended daily hours, the center provides essential shopping and services to the growing suburban community.
demographics: Weatherford Marketplace attracts a diverse mix of families and working professionals from the rapidly growing Weatherford area and surrounding Parker County communities. The primary trade area consists of middle-income households with median incomes ranging from $60,000 to $85,000, skewing toward younger families with children and established homeowners aged 30-55. The center serves as a convenient shopping destination for residents seeking everyday necessities and value-oriented retail options, with shopping patterns reflecting a preference for one-stop convenience and competitive pricing typical of suburban Texas markets.
description: Weatherford Marketplace serves as a prominent community shopping destination in Weatherford, Texas, anchored by Target and offering a comprehensive retail experience for Parker County residents. Located on South Main Street, this open-air shopping center has established itself as a go-to location for everyday shopping needs, combining national retailers with convenient services. The center features Target as its primary anchor, providing shoppers with access to groceries, household essentials, clothing, electronics, and home goods all under one roof. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily, Weatherford Marketplace accommodates busy schedules and serves as a central hub for the community's retail needs. The shopping center has earned a strong reputation among local shoppers, reflected in its 4.4-star rating from over 900 reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and its importance to the Weatherford community.
